title: Germ Warfare: The Flavor of Living Weapon

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Biomechanical civilization tampering with every stage of its organisms' life cycles and at war with the Mirrans.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: Inhabitants of Mirrodin at war with the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Flayer Husk
entities.description: Smallest living weapon, a clawed hand that scrabbles on its fingertips.

entities.name: Strandwalker
entities.description: Living weapon of jointed spiderlike necromechanical legs.

entities.name: Skinwing
entities.description: Living weapon of corroded metal with ragged skin wings.

entities.name: Bonehoard
entities.description: Living weapon of ligament, bone and metal that roves Mirrodin harvesting calcium.

entities.name: Mortarpod
entities.description: Living weapon, a walking metallic tube on a furnace-orb that launches its host.

entities.name: germ
entities.description: Vat-grown embryonic Phyrexian harvested in larval state to pilot living weapons.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: Figure with Keepers, green-aligned; more about her is to come.

entities.name: Tangle
entities.description: Green-aligned region of Mirrodin whose creatures fell readily to Phyrexian influence.

entities.name: vedalken
entities.description: Studious blue peoples infiltrated by Phyrexian poison counters.

events.summary: Phyrexians develop living weapons that can live on their own separate from a host body, powered by germs.
events.quote: The living weapons are autonomous Phyrexian body parts.

events.summary: Phyrexia spreads unevenly across the colors; black and green fell quickly, then blue and a little white, while red resists.
events.quote: Red mana, though, has shown the most resistance.

relations.quote: the war between the Phyrexians and the Mirrans
